name: allenlim-memory-server
description: Personal persistent memory — recalls relevant context before every response and captures every conversation. Backed by Cloudflare Agent Memory (managed hybrid search).

interface.shortDescription: Recall and capture personal memories in every conversation
interface.longDescription: Automatically searches your personal memory before every response and captures every conversation turn. Memories are stored with full-text search so past conversations, decisions, preferences, and facts are always available.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant memories for my current request.
